title: Sponsor
description: One paid advertising placement. Ads are DATA here, not code: a sponsor passes the same validation as every other record, so a malformed URL or an expired flight cannot render. A single record can run nationally or on a chosen set of states. See docs/ADVERTISING.md for the policy, including the accreditation requirement that governs anyone charging Veterans for claims help.

slot.description: Where it renders. jurisdiction requires a jurisdiction code.

image.description: Site-relative path under /sponsors/. Creatives are DOWNLOADED AND RE-HOSTED, never hotlinked: a hotlinked image is a third-party request that can be swapped for something else after we approved it.

policyReviewedBy.description: Who checked this against the advertising policy in docs/ADVERTISING.md, and when. Required: no ad runs without a named human having read the policy against it. Never put a claim-shark, pension-poaching, or GI Bill lead-gen advertiser on this site.

jurisdictions.description: Which jurisdiction pages this runs on. OMIT ENTIRELY for a national buy that runs on all 56. List state codes for a regional or single-state buy. This is what lets one record cover fifty states instead of fifty records.

advertiserCategory.description: What the advertiser sells. claims-representation triggers the mandatory accreditation and due-diligence checks in docs/ADVERTISING.md and must never be approved without them.

vaAccreditationNumber.description: REQUIRED when advertiserCategory is claims-representation. Only VA-accredited attorneys and claims agents may lawfully charge a Veteran a fee, and only for work after VA has issued a decision. Verify at the VA Office of General Counsel accreditation search before approval. An advertiser who cannot produce one is offering something they are not permitted to sell.

dueDiligence.description: Background checked before approval. Required for claims-representation and legal-other. Kept because a decision to run an ad aimed at Veterans should be reconstructable a year later.
